**What would someone say, and when would this be useful?**

**Recipe** (example; replace with your own):

```json
{"phrase":"match morning","steps":[{"kind":"time","city":"London"}]}
```

- [ ] I understand this issue will be public, including my GitHub username.
- [ ] The recipe contains no personal details, credentials, links, conversation logs or code.
- [ ] I tried the phrase in JARVIS and checked any factual quiz answer.

An issue is a proposal, not an installation. Maintainers review recipes before adding them to `community/skills.json`. See [the contribution guide](https://github.com/atulchoudhary7781-dot/Jarvis-AI/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
